description: Group Challenges - Create/join groups (max 10 people), daily leaderboard tracking pushups/food logs/protein target hits, weekly winner announcement, invite via WhatsApp share link.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/007_groups.sql - New tables: (1) `groups` with columns: id (uuid PK), name (text not null), created_by (uuid FK users), invite_code (text unique not null), max_members (int default 10), created_at (timestamptz). (2) `group_members` with columns: id (uuid PK), group_id (uuid FK groups on delete cascade), user_id (uuid FK users on delete cascade), joined_at (timestamptz default now()), unique(group_id, user_id). (3) `group_daily_scores` with columns: id (uuid PK), group_id (uuid FK groups on delete cascade), user_id (uuid FK users), score_date (date not null), food_logged (boolean default false), pushups_done (boolean default false), protein_hit (boolean default false), total_points (int default 0), unique(group_id, user_id, score_date). Add RLS policies: members can read their group data, service_role writes scores. Create indexes on group_members(group_id), group_members(user_id), group_daily_scores(group_id, score_date).

Create supabase/functions/create-group/index.ts - Edge Function: requireUser, takes name from body, generates a 6-char alphanumeric invite_code, creates group + inserts creator as first member. Returns group object.

Create supabase/functions/join-group/index.ts - Edge Function: requireUser, takes invite_code from body, finds group, checks member count < max_members, checks user not already a member, inserts into group_members. Returns group object.

Create supabase/functions/get-group-leaderboard/index.ts - Edge Function: requireUser, takes group_id from body, verifies user is a member, returns: (1) group info, (2) all members with their daily scores for current week, (3) weekly totals sorted by points descending. Computes scores by querying food_logs, pushup_sessions, and users (protein target) for each member for the requested date range.

Create supabase/functions/compute-group-scores/index.ts - CRON Edge Function (uses requireCron): iterates all groups, for each member computes today's score: +1 point for food logged today, +1 for pushup verified today, +1 for protein target hit (sum of food_log protein >= user.daily_protein_target). Upserts into group_daily_scores. This runs daily at 11pm IST.

Create lib/models/group_model.dart - GroupModel (id, name, inviteCode, createdBy, maxMembers, createdAt) and GroupMemberScore (userId, userName, foodLogged, pushupsDone, proteinHit, totalPoints, weeklyTotal).

Create lib/services/group_service.dart - Service with methods: createGroup(name), joinGroup(inviteCode), getMyGroups(), getGroupLeaderboard(groupId), shareGroupInvite(inviteCode, groupName) using share_plus.
Create lib/screens/groups/groups_screen.dart - Main groups screen: list of user's groups with create/join buttons. Each group card shows group name, member count, and user's rank this week.

Create lib/screens/groups/group_detail_screen.dart - Group detail: (1) Daily leaderboard table showing each member's status for today (checkmarks for food/pushup/protein), (2) Weekly total leaderboard sorted by points, (3) Invite button that shares WhatsApp link via share_plus, (4) Group name and member count header.
acceptance_criteria: Migration 007_groups.sql creates groups, group_members, group_daily_scores tables with proper FK constraints and RLS
create-group and join-group Edge Functions handle creation and membership correctly
get-group-leaderboard returns accurate scores for group members
compute-group-scores CRON function calculates daily scores from food_logs, pushup_sessions, and protein targets
GroupsScreen lists user's groups with create/join functionality
GroupDetailScreen shows daily and weekly leaderboards with member scores
verification: Verify SQL migration is syntactically valid with proper table references
Verify all Edge Functions import from _shared/common.ts correctly
Verify new Dart files have valid syntax and follow project patterns
